parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `RadioPlayerBehaviorTests.radioPlayerStopCallsUnderlyingPlayer` (line 37) and `RadioPlayerBehaviorTests.radioPlayerStopResetsStream` (line 53) — carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.818 indicates structurally near-duplicate test methods, these are distinct behavioral assertions: one verifies that stopping the player calls the underlying player, and the other verifies that stopping resets the stream. Merging or extracting them would obscure the separate failure signals each test is designed to surface, which is the canonical reason test fixtures are exempted from deduplication. No production code is involved in this cluster.
